name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2024-03-25.125.1) introduced by Melbourne MP [Adam Bandt](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/melbourne/adam_bandt) (Greens), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That so much of the standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the question for the second reading of the Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Legislation Amendment (Safety and Other Measures) Bill 2024 being put to the House for decision only when the Government's the Government's amendments to the bill have been considered by a Senate inquiry.* Standing and sessional orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
